newsitem.title: USA: Royal Casino Group posts FY96 revenues.
newsitem.headline: Royal Casino Group posts FY96 revenues.

text.p: Royal Casino Group Inc, which changed to an operating company from a development-stage company with the acquisition of Goldiggers Hotel and Gaming Establishment in South Dakota, said revenues for 49 days of operations at the casino in fiscal 1996 ending July 31 were $416,205.

President Jon Elliott said, "Our improved balance sheet affords us the wherewithal to grow the company as we continue our pursuit to acquire, develop and manage casinos in small to mid-sized North American markets."
Elliott also said Royal Casino was approaching the assets it needs to apply for listing on the Nasdaq Small Cap Market.
He said the company plans to file an application with the Missouri Gaming Commission in the current fiscal quarter to proceed with its Missouri Riverboat project in Wyatt, Mo.
